name: stock_returns
summary: RMA and vendor-direct returns with policy eligibility, dispositions and inspection-gated restock
description: Customer return authorizations and vendor direct-to-return orders captured against the originating delivery with per-line condition and lot/serial evidence. Policy windows decide eligibility; dispositions (restock, quarantine, repair, return-to-vendor, scrap, reject) execute through the validated move ledger, and restock stays gated on inspection until a quality sign-off exists (blueprint section 12).
author: Nexa
